---
title: "Trap: a character only the display face is asked to set"
mdbrand:
  brand: dejavu
  style: report
  confidential: "機密"
---

The label is set on the cover and in every footer in the display face, which
has no CJK. The .docx check looked at the body's text alone and passed it; Word
would have set the label in whatever face it found.
